Coca-Cola Stock Analysis: 60 Years of Market Performance

Executive Summary

This report presents a comprehensive quantitative analysis of Coca-Cola KO stock performance over a 60-year period from January 1962 to October 2022. The analysis reveals exceptional long-term performance with a compound annual growth rate CAGR of 12.35%, transforming a 0.05 investment in 1962 into 59.39 by 2022 — a total return of 118,642%. The stock demonstrated remarkable stability through multiple market cycles, with consistently low volatility and reliable dividend payments, validating its reputation as a defensive blue-chip investment.

Key Findings

  • Total Return: 118,642% over 60 years CAGR: 12.35%
  • Stability: Low average volatility of 1.46% daily returns
  • Dividend History: 242 dividend events totaling 25.69
  • Best Performance: 2019 +21.68%, 2021 +15.76%
  • Worst Performance: 1974 -24.47%, 2008 -23.70%
  • Market Resilience: Recovered strongly from major crashes 1987, 2000, 2008

Notably, volatility quickly normalizes, demonstrating Coca-Cola's resilience and fundamental business stability.

10. Predictive Insights

Long-Term Trend Analysis

Based on 60 years of historical data, Coca-Cola demonstrates:

1. Consistent Growth: 12.35% CAGR through multiple economic cycles

2. Low Volatility: Below-market volatility with quick recovery from drawdowns

3. Defensive Characteristics: Outperforms during bear markets

4. Dividend Growth: Consistent dividend increases support total returns

Key Success Factors

  • Brand Strength: One of the world's most valuable brands
  • Global Distribution: Presence in 200+ countries
  • Product Diversification: Beyond soda to water, tea, coffee, energy drinks
  • Financial Discipline: Strong balance sheet and capital allocation
  • Dividend Growth: 60+ consecutive years of dividend increases Dividend King

Risk Factors

  • Health Consciousness: Declining soda consumption in developed markets
  • Currency Exposure: International revenue subject to FX fluctuations
  • Commodity Risk: Sugar, aluminum, and packaging cost volatility
  • Regulatory Risk: Sugar taxes and beverage regulations
  • Market Saturation: Limited growth opportunities in developed markets

Conclusion

Coca-Cola's 60-year stock performance represents one of the most compelling case studies in long-term investing. The combination of:

1. Exceptional Total Returns: 118,642% 12.35% CAGR

2. Low Volatility: Consistent stability through market cycles

3. Resilience: Quick recovery from major drawdowns

4. Dividend Growth: Reliable and growing income stream

5. Business Quality: Strong competitive moat and global reach

...makes Coca-Cola a benchmark for quality defensive investing. The stock has rewarded patient shareholders with extraordinary returns while maintaining relatively low risk compared to the broader market.

Investment Verdict

Analysis conducted using Polars for high-performance data processing and Plotly for interactive visualization. Data covers 15,311 trading days from January 2, 1962 to October 26, 2022.
